newsitem.title: USA: Thermadyne to sell unit for about $102 million.
newsitem.headline: Thermadyne to sell unit for about $102 million.

text.p: Thermadyne Holdings Corp. said Monday it agreed to sell its Deloro Stellite Holdings Corp. unit, a maker of wear-resistant components, to a group led by management for $95 million in cash and the assumption of $7.5 million in debt.
Stellite Holdings, which makes hard-faced materials and other products, had 1996 sales of about $109 million.
"Divestiture of the wear resistance business will complete Thermadyne's strategic refocusing around its core cutting and welding activities," Thermadyne Chief Executive Gerald Curran said.
Investors welcomed the announcement. Thermadyne stock rose rose $1.125 to $30.375 on Nasdaq.
The deal is subject to customary conditions and is expected to close in the third quarter, the St. Louis-based company said.
